mapper.select: SELECT MODEL_VERSION FROM MODEL_REGISTRY WHERE STATUS_CODE = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ACTIVATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT S.SPLIT_CODE AS splitCode, S.WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, S.LABEL_ANY_DELINQUENCY_12M AS labelAnyDelinquency12m, S.LABEL_NONFIN_EFFECT_12M AS labelNonfinEffect12m, S.SCORE_LEGACY_DELINQ AS scoreLegacyDelinq, S.SCORE_ALT_DELINQ AS scoreAltDelinq, S.SCORE_LEGACY_NONFIN AS scoreLegacyNonfin, S.SCORE_ALT_NONFIN AS scoreAltNonfin FROM MODEL_EVAL_SAMPLE S JOIN DIM_WORKER_TYPE W ON W.WORKER_TYPE_CODE = S.WORKER_TYPE_CODE WHERE S.MODEL_VERSION = #{modelVersion} AND S.GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode} AND S.SPLIT_CODE IN ('TRAIN', 'VALID') ORDER BY W.DISPLAY_ORDER, S.EVAL_SAMPLE_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
JSON_VALUE(METRICS_JSON, '$.same_label_comparison.by_label.label_nonfin_effect_12m.legacy.mean' RETURNING NUMBER) AS legacyAuc, JSON_VALUE(METRICS_JSON, '$.same_label_comparison.by_label.label_nonfin_effect_12m.alternative.mean' RETURNING NUMBER) AS alternativeAuc
JSON_VALUE(METRICS_JSON, '$.same_label_comparison.by_label.label_any_delinquency_12m.legacy.mean' RETURNING NUMBER) AS legacyAuc, JSON_VALUE(METRICS_JSON, '$.same_label_comparison.by_label.label_any_delinquency_12m.alternative.mean' RETURNING NUMBER) AS alternativeAuc
, ARTIFACT_NAME FROM MODEL_ARTIFACT WHERE MODEL_VERSION = #{modelVersion} ) WHERE legacyAuc IS NOT NULL AND alternativeAuc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ARTIFACT_NAME FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
